paragraphs: Isi son of Mahalalel, Pesachim 113b. Akavya son of Mahalalel, Avot, beginning of chapter 3.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: קיג: gives Pesachim 113b under the colon convention, without fresh edition verification.
רפ״ג gives beginning of Avot chapter 3; no modern mishnah number is inserted.

פ״ה-יב gives Genesis 5:12. The biblical son of Kenan, Isi’s father and Akavya’s father are separate uses grouped by the name; they do not establish one person or family. No personal title is supplied for any listed name.
